snippet.title: Potions Galore - Official Demo Announcement Trailer | OUT October 12th
snippet.description:
We are excited to share that a free demo for Potions Galore is coming up on October 12th on Steam!

Potions Galore is a cozy tidy-up game where you pick up potions to discover their lore, read it in the book and deduce the correct category. 

Wishlist now on Steam to be notified!

#sortinggame  #indiegamedev #cozygaming #gamedevelopment  #wishlistnow
